values.note: Twelve sites, nine of them tent-only. Three take an RV or trailer: site 001 (max vehicle 25 ft, the campground's accessible site, stone-dust pad) and sites 003 and 004 (20 ft). Only site 001 takes a 23-ft rig, and DCR asks a party that does not need an accessible site to pick another unless it is the only one available.

note:
Limited number of RV spots.  $40 non-resident.  Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
Wooded sites on a slope down to 35-acre Benedict Pond (swimming, car-top boating, the Benedict Pond loop trail); the few shoreline sites are tent-only. Black bears visit: food lockers at every site. Cell service is limited. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: $14/$40 (DCR's 2026 Limited Service tier - the note's '$40 non-resident' is CURRENT, not stale; stored fees right), 2026 season 5/14-10/25 (matches; 'NO OFF SEASON CAMPING'), no hookups, no dump, no showers, fresh water, reservations required. Added 12 sites, max 25 ft, RA booking url; hookups/facilities/booking/sites filled. Only ONE site takes a 23-ft rig (see criteria flag). The unmarked first note line kept verbatim (nothing contradicts it); the --Claude line rewritten (the shoreline sites are tent-only). Pin is in the campground (RA GPS 42.20583,-73.29194, ~40 m). Not waterfront kept.
flags: CRITERIA (rig length): only one of the 12 sites takes a 23-ft motorhome. RA's site list has 9 TENT ONLY sites and 3 STANDARD NON ELECTRIC: 001 rated 25 ft, 003 and 004 rated 20 ft (the inclusion_evidence's 'sites 1/3/4 for trailers/RVs up to 25 ft' is out of date for 3 and 4). Site 001 is the accessible site: 'Universal Access Site: Y', 'Max Vehicle Length: 25' (beside 'Driveway Length: 10'), 'Reservable by anyone', but 'If no one in your party needs an accessible site, please select another site unless this is the only one available at the time of your request.' So EKKO can book Beartown only on site 001, as a fallback DCR discourages. Compare Otter River (p3-193, dropped when no trailer-capable site reached 23 ft). A human decides.
Phone missing: give 413-528-0904 (mass.gov '(413) 528-0904'; RA 'Campground Phone Number: 413-528-0904').

Toilets conflict (flush_toilets left unset): RA's description says 'offers flushable toilets', but its amenity list says 'Toilet, Pit/Vault' and site 001's alert says 'Accessible composting toilets are provided nearby. There are no flush toilets or showers at this campground.'

Waterfront (informational, not changed): RA says 'A few coveted sites are right on the shoreline of the pond' and tags 009, 010, 011 Near Water, but all three are tent-only; site 001, the one 23-ft site, carries no Near Water tag. Not waterfront stands for EKKO.
Note's first line (unmarked, possibly AWH's) kept verbatim: '$40 non-resident' matches DCR's 2026 table (Beartown is Limited Service, $14/$40), so it is current rather than stale against $54.
